info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Hotel Rooms Inventorys-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Inventory API provides a comprehensive view of available rooms within a hotel's inventory. It enables users to retrieve detailed information on all rooms, including their status, pricing, and amenities. This endpoint is essential for hotel management systems, booking platforms, and travel agencies seeking to present real-time room availability to their customers. Developers can integrate this API to enhance user experiences with accurate data on hotel accommodations, facilitating informed bookings.

get.summary: Retrieve the current inventory of rooms
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch a comprehensive list of available rooms, including their statuses and details. Ideal for front-end applications needing to display room availability to users.
